annotations.title: Find the same records in other systems

description: AI Agents: Use for questions across systems, such as which won deals have no invoice yet: for up to 50 records it returns the same records in the customer's other systems, as their syncs link them. Not for links inside one system (use list_related_records).

ids.description: The ids of the records, at most 50.

system.description: The AI agent's system or connection name.

type.description: The record type, such as contact or invoice.

name: find_linked_records
title: Find the same records in other systems
